scope: IDC index and complete per-instance source metadata audit only; no pixel downloads or conversion validation

findings.pet_philips_dynamic: 45 times x 45 slices; complete native ImageIndex; increasing FrameReferenceTime. Sorting InstanceNumber alone reverses temporal blocks. Source ActualFrameDuration is uniformly 4996 ms despite varying FrameReferenceTime intervals; do not invent durations.
findings.pet_siemens_dynamic: 45 times x 74 slices; complete native ImageIndex; increasing FrameReferenceTime. Native slice traversal is descending LPS Z (minus 3 mm), unlike the previously tested GE cases. Reader compatibility must be tested; not claimed here.
findings.mr_qin_breast_dynamic: 25 explicit temporal positions x 20 sagittal slices, identical grid and increasing acquisition times; 69.45 s gap among mostly 17.49 s intervals. Do not encode a fabricated uniform elapsed-time axis.
findings.ct_respiratory: Ten classic CT series, 0 through 90 percent respiratory phases, 50 slices each. Coordinate grids match, but there are two FrameOfReferenceUID values. No TemporalPositionIdentifier, TriggerTime or NominalPercentageOfRespiratoryPhase in these headers. Phase percentages come from SeriesDescription plus collection provenance, not a measured time axis. Do not silently merge or rewrite spatial identity.
findings.ct_dynamic_description_only: Negative selection example: nine unique positions, each imaged once; DYNAMIC MODE description does not establish 4D acquisition.

queries.pet_non_ge_dynamic:
SELECT i.collection_id, i.PatientID, i.StudyInstanceUID, i.SeriesInstanceUID,
i.SeriesDescription, i.Manufacturer, i.ManufacturerModelName, i.SOPClassUID,
i.instanceCount, i.series_size_MB, i.license_short_name, i.source_DOI,
i.series_aws_url, i.series_revised_idc_version, p.SeriesType, p.Units, p.DecayCorrection,
               p.NumberOfSlices, p.NumberOfTimeSlices, p.ActualFrameDuration,
               p.Rows, p.Columns
        FROM index i JOIN pt_index p USING (SeriesInstanceUID)
        WHERE i.Manufacturer IN ('SIEMENS', 'Philips Medical Systems')
          AND p.SeriesType='DYNAMIC/IMAGE' AND p.NumberOfTimeSlices > 1
          AND p.Units='BQML'
        ORDER BY i.Manufacturer, i.series_size_MB, i.SeriesInstanceUID
queries.pet_non_ge_3d:
SELECT i.collection_id, i.PatientID, i.StudyInstanceUID, i.SeriesInstanceUID,
i.SeriesDescription, i.Manufacturer, i.ManufacturerModelName, i.SOPClassUID,
i.instanceCount, i.series_size_MB, i.license_short_name, i.source_DOI,
i.series_aws_url, i.series_revised_idc_version, p.SeriesType, p.Units, p.DecayCorrection,
               p.NumberOfSlices, p.NumberOfTimeSlices, p.Rows, p.Columns
        FROM index i JOIN pt_index p USING (SeriesInstanceUID)
        WHERE i.Manufacturer IN ('SIEMENS', 'Siemens', 'Philips Medical Systems')
          AND p.SeriesType IN ('STATIC/IMAGE', 'WHOLE BODY/IMAGE')
          AND p.Units='BQML' AND i.instanceCount>=40
          AND i.license_short_name IN ('CC BY 3.0', 'CC BY 4.0')
        QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY i.Manufacturer ORDER BY i.series_size_MB, i.SeriesInstanceUID)<=3
        ORDER BY i.Manufacturer, i.series_size_MB
queries.mr_dynamic_candidates:
SELECT i.collection_id, i.PatientID, i.StudyInstanceUID, i.SeriesInstanceUID,
i.SeriesDescription, i.Manufacturer, i.ManufacturerModelName, i.SOPClassUID,
i.instanceCount, i.series_size_MB, i.license_short_name, i.source_DOI,
i.series_aws_url, i.series_revised_idc_version, m.NumberOfTemporalPositions, m.EchoTime,
               m.DiffusionBValue, m.Rows, m.Columns, m.MRAcquisitionType,
               m.ScanningSequence, m.SequenceName
        FROM index i JOIN mr_index m USING (SeriesInstanceUID)
        JOIN collections_index c ON i.collection_id=c.collection_id
        WHERE m.NumberOfTemporalPositions >= 3 AND m.Rows>=64 AND m.Columns>=64
          AND i.instanceCount>=m.NumberOfTemporalPositions*10
          AND i.instanceCount % m.NumberOfTemporalPositions=0
          AND i.license_short_name IN ('CC BY 3.0', 'CC BY 4.0')
          AND c.species='Human'
        ORDER BY i.series_size_MB, i.SeriesInstanceUID LIMIT 18
queries.ct_4d_inventory:
SELECT i.collection_id, i.PatientID, i.StudyInstanceUID, count(*) series_count,
               sum(i.instanceCount) instances, sum(i.series_size_MB) total_mb,
               list(i.SeriesDescription ORDER BY i.SeriesDescription) descriptions,
               list(distinct i.license_short_name) licenses
        FROM index i
        WHERE i.Modality='CT' AND i.collection_id IN ('4d_lung','ct_vs_pet_ventilation_imaging')
        GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY total_mb LIMIT 15
queries.ct_dynamic_candidates:
SELECT i.collection_id, i.PatientID, i.StudyInstanceUID, i.SeriesInstanceUID,
i.SeriesDescription, i.Manufacturer, i.ManufacturerModelName, i.SOPClassUID,
i.instanceCount, i.series_size_MB, i.license_short_name, i.source_DOI,
i.series_aws_url, i.series_revised_idc_version, c.ImageType, c.ScanOptions, c.Rows, c.Columns
        FROM index i JOIN ct_index c USING (SeriesInstanceUID)
        WHERE regexp_matches(lower(coalesce(i.SeriesDescription,'')), 'perfusion|dynamic|4d')
          AND i.license_short_name IN ('CC BY 3.0', 'CC BY 4.0')
        ORDER BY i.series_size_MB, i.SeriesInstanceUID LIMIT 25
queries.mr_dce:
SELECT i.collection_id, i.PatientID, i.StudyInstanceUID, i.SeriesInstanceUID,
i.SeriesDescription, i.Manufacturer, i.ManufacturerModelName, i.SOPClassUID,
i.instanceCount, i.series_size_MB, i.license_short_name, i.source_DOI,
i.series_aws_url, i.series_revised_idc_version, m.NumberOfTemporalPositions, m.EchoTime, m.DiffusionBValue,
               m.Rows, m.Columns, m.ScanningSequence, m.MRAcquisitionType
        FROM index i JOIN mr_index m USING (SeriesInstanceUID)
        WHERE m.NumberOfTemporalPositions >= 4 AND m.Rows>=64 AND m.Columns>=64
          AND i.instanceCount>=m.NumberOfTemporalPositions*10
          AND i.instanceCount % m.NumberOfTemporalPositions=0
          AND i.license_short_name IN ('CC BY 3.0', 'CC BY 4.0')
          AND regexp_matches(lower(coalesce(i.SeriesDescription,'')), 'dyn|dce|perf')
          AND coalesce(array_length(m.DiffusionBValue), 0)=0
          AND array_length(m.EchoTime)=1
        QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY i.collection_id ORDER BY i.series_size_MB, i.SeriesInstanceUID)<=2
        ORDER BY i.series_size_MB, i.SeriesInstanceUID LIMIT 16
